author: THSV StreamBridge
description: An instant photo on stream. A reward, an alert or a button drops a camera onto the stream, the flash fires, and a photo of your camera prints out with the viewer's message on it. Every snap is saved in your folder with the date and time as its name.
changelog: 4.1.133: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.133, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.1.104: initial release with the village camera, flash and print animation, two photo frames, captions from reward messages, alerts that snap by themselves, cooldowns, a queue, scenes where the camera is put away, rewards given back when no snap is taken, saving to your folder and optional Discord posts.

manifest.name: Snap
installationSteps: OBS only: Connect OBS Studio under Scene connections, then pick the OBS source Snap takes the picture of (usually your camera).
SprigCast only: Add SprigCast under Scene connections, then pick the SprigCast source Snap takes the picture of (usually your camera).
Name the rewards that take a snap, and pick a folder for the pictures.
Add the overlay as a browser source in the scenes where snaps should show, then press Take a snap in the Control Panel.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source. Your saved pictures stay in your folder.

healthChecks.description: Confirms rewards, alerts and the Control Panel take one snap at a time, cooldowns and paused scenes are respected, and skipped rewards are given back.
